method: Native macOS key events through Computer Use in a signed-in Cursor development window; no pasted Japanese for composition checks
checks: Romaji key input converts to Japanese in a heading; Space and Shift+Space cycle candidates, Return commits
Paragraph input converts tuika to 追加; commit produces a marker and explicit save writes the file
Table cell converts kakuninn to 確認; file remains unchanged while draft is unsaved
Closing and reopening the preview restores the unsaved table cell and its unreviewed change
Colored text converts hozonn to 保存; Undo removes and Redo restores the committed Japanese
Explicit save preserves both color HTML tags and all Japanese content exactly
Source textarea converts nihonngo to 日本語; two Esc presses cancel and restore original source and saved state
Fold all hides the body and table while showing four changes; unfold all restores content without changing the file
limitations: Focused native regression pass, not the entire 68-check VS Code UI suite
Candidate changes were observed in preedit text; separate OS candidate-window layout was not captured
Other input methods, Windows, Linux and remote hosts were not tested
